answer: Stylometric fingerprinting: graders embed every answer and measure how close each pair sits in style space, from phrase rhythm to error habits. One operator steering 300 identities leaves the same fingerprint, a canyon-deep groove that no prompt shuffle fully hides, so matching clusters share a single reward. Masking it means paying for genuinely different models, prompts and editing per fake, copper spent on every answer, while an honest agent's natural voice, bending like willow, costs nothing to keep.
